rule_or_requirement: A pixel-only obstacle warning must precede collision with enough time to change speed while avoiding broad false alarms on valid finishes.
observable_information: Rendered grayscale obstacle row and lateral position across consecutive frames plus pixel HUD speed; simulator collision and distance are evaluation labels only.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Record one fixed visual time-to-contact warning while leaving both pixel drivers' actions untouched.
expected_success_endpoint: Warning 5–12 decisions before each first student collision and at most two total warnings in each valid selected-control run.
control: Unchanged selected stable-risk pixel driver on 1:5020 and 2:5021; unchanged frozen three-class pixel student on the same cells.
falsifier: No timely warning before either student collision or more than two warnings in a successful selected-control run.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Four unchanged episodes on two previously consumed TRAIN identities 1:5020 and 2:5021.
resource_and_risk_gate: One registered Linux CPU sensor-only diagnostic capped at 900 seconds and 2,000 decisions per episode; no fresh competitive or external action.
